summary: cli_parse in ansible.utils 1.0.0+ can run a CLI command and parse its output, or parse any text, using cli_parser plugins for various engines.
questions: Can cli_parse parse text that isn't from a device?

answer_card.title: What cli_parse does
answer_card.answer_md: `cli_parse` is in `ansible.utils` (1.0.0+). It either runs a CLI command on a device and parses the result, or parses any text you give it. Parsing is done by cli_parser plugins for different engines. Useful for CLI-only devices whose commands return semi-structured text.
